comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Quest Name: After King Khufu
Requirement: Pyramids of Giza discovery + Book of Wisdom obtained
Quest locations: Marseille/Genoa/Tunis/Istanbul
Skills: R1 Search / R3 Archaeology / Arabic (not needed)

Steps:

1. Talk to Scholar x2 (Istanbul Archives)
2. Enter Giza Plateau from Cairo Opposite Shore landing point. Discovery is located by the middle-lower column on your survey map, close to the Pyramid Dungeon entrance. Bring perception of artisans/Observe skill if you need to.

Quest complete. This serves to unlock the new Legacy theme "Ancient Civilization in the Desert" from your Book of Wisdom. Cheers.

Screenshot ref: blog.goo.ne.jp/triptych/e/cf48ff8a5e230b4296aa5da670d2c131

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Note: this quest is repeatable. You won't need to run it again after unlocking the Legacy theme but if any friends/company mates need help pulling it for some reason, you can do so for them.
